title: Choose VEYRA's visual world
question: The roll assigned the Passbook Ledger. Keep it, take the pick or the category standard, or re-roll.

options.label: Passbook Ledger
options.lineage: Indonesian bank passbooks (buku tabungan): dot-matrix entries, running balance, teller stamps
options.thesis: Every animal keeps a passbook: each observation, valuation, premium, and claim posts as a numbered, dated line, and nothing financial posts without a stamp.
options.viewport: Passbook-blue rail with nav. Herd table with exposure ranges and coverage. On the right, the selected cow's passbook: numbered entries, a running insured-vs-exposure column, and one line awaiting its stamp.
options.risk: Can drift toward a banking app; the stamp must stay a precise state marker, never a skeuomorphic gimmick.

raised.raise: Evidence frames are registered: muzzle, teeth, and body render at one fixed scale and crop, so enrollment and later observations compare side by side.
The herd table and the camera pen map share one coordinate space: picking an animal anywhere jumps to its last-seen position.
Financial decisions are isolated: Decline sits apart from Approve with deliberate space, and a stamp binds only the focused line.
Capacity is visible: the remaining sandbox balance prints on the line before you stamp, and a premium cannot overflow it.
One visible column rhythm: herd, passbook, ledger, and claims align to the same column grid on every screen.
Figures print in true near-black on white for daylight; tint never touches a number.

options.label: Ear Tag
options.lineage: Livestock ear tags: molded tag-yellow plastic, laser-black numerals
options.thesis: Identity is the anchor: every cow appears as its ear tag, so whether it is confirmed reads before anything else.
options.viewport: Black top bar. Herd table whose first column is a tag-yellow chip with a large numeral. Confirmed animals have solid tags, pending ones outlined tags, and unassigned tracks a grey 'no tag'.
options.risk: The most familiar livestock signifier and where most runs land; yellow-on-black can read as hazard signage.

options.label: Botanical Folio
options.thesis: One cow shown at fixed scale through every stage of its record.
options.viewport: Fixed-scale plates of the same animal across dates.
options.case: Farm managers do not identify with botanical folios; the cream plate ground fights field contrast.
options.kept: Registered, fixed-scale comparison of the same subject over time.

options.label: Convention Catalog
options.thesis: The herd as a stamp-sized grid keyed to a pen map.
options.viewport: Thumbnail grid keyed to a hall map.
options.risk: Reads as fan ephemera, not an evidence system.
options.case: No audience link, and newsprint density hides identity state.
options.kept: The catalog and the map are one space.

options.label: Dark Console
options.thesis: Graphite panels with hairline seams and isolated destructive actions.
options.case: The brief is daylight tablet use; a dark console fails it and reads as a developer tool.
options.kept: Destructive actions isolated by deliberate empty space.

options.label: Cassette J-Card
options.thesis: Two sides that must never overflow the tape.
options.case: Nostalgic and handwritten, the opposite of precise and accountable.
options.kept: Capacity made visible so nothing overflows.

options.label: Grid Specimen
options.thesis: A visible construction grid with grid-built numerals.
options.risk: Poster type fights dense operational data.
options.case: Specimen-poster type is a display gesture that working tables cannot carry.
options.kept: One real, visible grid that everything snaps to.

options.label: Datamatics
options.risk: No colour for state; strobing is hostile.
options.case: Removes the state colours the brief requires and adds hostile motion.
options.kept: True black-on-white figures for maximum contrast.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A clean agritech SaaS dashboard: white canvas, side nav, KPI tiles, herd table, one blue accent, executed at full craft.
canonCard.viewport: Side nav, a row of KPI tiles (herd value, insured, alerts, approvals), then the herd table.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from every farm-management dashboard by design.
